data.name: Mughir
data.gender_notes: Mughir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who conquers or overcomes obstacles. The name Mughir carries the meaning “Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mughir usually hope their child will grow to embody conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who have a strong spirit and overcome adversity
data.etymology: Mughir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mughir total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مُغِير
in_arabic.meaning: المغير اسم من غيرا يغير تغيرا فهو مغير و مغير
in_arabic.long_meaning: المغير اسم من غيرا يغير تغيرا فهو مغير و مغير، من أسماء الله الحسنى، ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران آية ١٢٤ {وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَصْحَابُهُ مُغِيرِينَ عَلَى الكُفَّارِ رِجَالاً وَخَيلاً وَلَولا إِذاً جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ انقِلاباً وَلَجَعَلَ مُصِيراً}

in_urdu.name: مغیر
in_urdu.meaning: مغیر ۔ اللہ تعالیٰ کا نام ۔ بدلنے والا ۔
in_urdu.long_meaning: مغیر ۔ اللہ تعالیٰ کا نام ۔ بدلنے والا ۔ تبدیل کرنے والا، اللہ کی صفت ہے، قرآن مجید میں آیا ہے {وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَصْحَابُهُ مُغِيرِينَ عَلَى الكُفَّارِ رِجَالاً وَخَيلاً وَلَولا إِذاً جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ انقِلاباً وَلَجَعَلَ مُصِيراً}

in_hindi.name: मुग़ीर
in_hindi.meaning: मुग़ीर का अर्थ है बदलने वाला, अल्लाह का नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुग़ीर नाम अल्लाह के नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है बदलने वाला या परिवर्तित करने वाला। यह नाम कुरआन में सूरत आले इमरान में उल्लेखित है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है और अक्सर बच्चों के नामकरण में उपयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: مغير
in_pashto.meaning: مغير د بدلونکی معنا لري، د الله نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: مغير د بدلونکی معنا لري، د الله نوم، په قران کريم کې يې د آل عمران سورت په ١٢٤ آيت کې يادونه شوې ده {وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَصْحَابُهُ مُغِيرِينَ عَلَى الكُفَّارِ رِجَالاً وَخَيلاً وَلَولا إِذاً جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ انقِلاباً وَلَجَعَلَ مُصِيراً}

in_english.name: Mughir
in_english.meaning: Mughir means changer, transformer, one of Allah's names
in_english.long_meaning: Mughir is one of the names of Allah, meaning changer or transformer. It is derived from the Arabic root 'ghy-r' which means to change or alter. The name Mughir is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al Imran, verse 124. In Islamic tradition, Mughir signifies the power to change or modify circumstances. The name holds significant spiritual meaning and is often used in Muslim cultures for naming children.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل مکھیر
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل مغير

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mughir" is significant in Islamic history and culture, as it emphasizes the power of perseverance, resilience, and triumph over challenges. It is a name that holds a deep sense of pride and accomplishment, especially for those who have faced and overcome adversity in their lives. In the Islamic context, this name can be seen as a reminder of the powerful bond between hard work, determination, and success.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name "Mughir" can be seen as a reminder of the power of God in helping us conquer our inner and outer struggles. It can be a source of inspiration to continue seeking guidance and strength from Allah, especially when facing difficult situations or challenges. The name also highlights the importance of trusting in Allah's plan for our lives and having faith that He will help us overcome obstacles, no matter how insurmountable they may seem. Ultimately, the name "Mughir" encourages us to believe in our inherent worth and ability to triumph, both in this world and beyond, with the help and support of Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Conqueror" symbolizes The one who conquers or overcomes obstacles. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mughir serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of conqueror.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa al-Nihayah: Volume 13, Page 442 The name Mughir carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mughir al-Din Abu Zakariya Yusuf ibn Firuz Shah, a Sultan of Delhi from the Slave Dynasty, ruled from 1240 to 1244 AD.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Khaldun's The Muqaddimah: Volume 1, Page 273 The name Mughir carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mughir al-Din Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad al-Mansur, a Hafsid ruler of Al-Andalus, reigned from 1310 to 1316 AD.

On social media platforms, Mughir is used as a hashtag to inspire and uplift individuals, especially during times of hardship. Mobile applications like Muslim Pro offer daily duas and prayers, and the name Mughir is sometimes used as a reminder of Allah's help and deliverance. In the realm of e-commerce, there are various brands and products that bear the name Mughir, often promoting spiritual growth and personal development through their offerings.
